metadata.description: Static security audit for projects extending Claude Code (skills, agents, hooks, MCP servers, slash commands) before installing them locally. Detects backdoors, prompt injection, persistence hooks, and supply-chain risks via parallel sub-agents.

plugins.name: plugin-auditor
plugins.description: Static security audit for GitHub/GitLab repositories before installing them in Claude Code. A single user-invocable skill (/plugin-auditor:audit) orchestrates five parallel sub-agents (static, claude-artifacts, supply-chain, config, network-fs) and produces a markdown report with a NO FINDINGS / CAUTION / UNSAFE verdict.
